result.summary: Found 3 issues: an untranslated/placeholder text string being the most critical, plus minor layout cropping issues in the horizontal scroll sections.

issues.description: The section title displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated text, indicating a missing translation string.
issues.suggestion: Fix the localization file/key mapping so the actual title (e.g., 'Popular near you') renders instead of the raw key.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list, the third card (Trattoria Piccolo) is cut off at the edge of the screen, and its name text is truncated ('Piccol...').
issues.suggestion: Add proper edge padding/fade indicator for horizontally scrollable lists, or truncate text with ellipsis clearly instead of hard-cutting the card.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) has an additional partially visible chip cut off at the right edge, suggesting the scrollable row isn't clearly indicating more content.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade gradient or partial visibility cue at the edge to indicate horizontal scrollability more clearly.

issues.description: The pizza promotional image at the bottom of the screen is abruptly cropped by the bottom navigation bar, cutting off part of the content before the user can see full details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure sufficient bottom padding/margin above the navigation bar so content isn't awkwardly cropped mid-image.
